name: the_two_lists_do_not_see_each_other
why: THE TRAP OF THE ENTRY, measured. The properties of the document and those of a configuration are two separate lists: they are not inherited and do not see each other. Whoever writes the drawing number on the document and then looks for it among the properties of the configuration DOES NOT FIND IT, and SOLIDWORKS does not say why. It is the defect that gives no error: the data sheet comes out empty and the part is right.
_why_here_and_not_in_the_catalog: The note in the catalogue is read by whoever chooses the operation; this case keeps it true. The day a version of SOLIDWORKS began to inherit them, the note would stay written and wrong: this case would turn red.

expect.why: written on the DOCUMENT, it cannot be seen from the active configuration
written on the CONFIGURATION, it cannot be seen from the document: it is the same wall looked at from the other side
the one of the document is still there where we put it
and the one of the configuration is in the other list. They are two fields in the state on purpose: a single field would be a merge that does not exist in the file.

expect._why_true: NOW IT CAN BE SEEN FROM THERE, but because there is one of ITS OWN with the same name -- not because it is the same one. This line is here because the «false» of the lines above must be a measured fact and not a constant written by hand: a field that always answers false is indistinguishable from a right field, until the case is built in which it must answer true.
